_about: Reference standards the owner wants reported as HELD or MISSING before a blind test, whether or not any document cites them yet (W5b-08, #532). Groups and entries are DATA: edit here, not in code. An entry is a standard's designation as people write it; the report decides held/missing with the same rule the cited-but-not-held report uses (standard_ids.same_standard), so 'IEC 61511' finds a library file named 'iec-61511-1'. A group with no entries is reported as 'no standards listed', never as 'all held'. The company-procedure group is empty on purpose: which company procedure standards govern a review is the client engineer's list (#682) - add them here when it exists.
